title: 三幅样式雷圆明园河道全图辨析: west road of 九洲清晏 after 1828
summary_en: Sequence of works on Yangshi Lei plans: after 1828 清晖阁 became 湛静斋 with 穿堂殿 and 后殿; 1831 怡情书史 and its fish pond gave way to 慎德堂; 1836 the three axis halls were rebuilt and 同道堂 added; 1846 the four courts of 洞天深处 became two. This fits the labels 前殿, ?顺堂, 后殿 on S01 as the former 湛静斋 group.
caveat: A reading of Qing plans, not a reconstruction.
notes: From the evidence catalogue of Round 3.

institution: 圆明园管理处; 北京大学考古文博学院

This is the nearest thing found to a 'Peking University Digital Yuanmingyuan'. It says over 10 sites have been dug since the 1990s.

title: 《圆明园新证》: reading of Palace Museum plan No. 1704, stripped of its later paste-ups to the Qianlong layout of about 1779
method_stated: Base sheet dated by listing what the plan shows against the Forty Scenes, poems and palace archives; paste-up layers and whited-out parts read separately for Jiaqing and Daoguang changes.
caveat: A reading of Qing plans, not a reconstruction.
notes: A plan reading, not a reconstruction drawing: closest thing found for most of these scenes. The text says the original forms of 接秀山房 and 北远山村 can be recovered from it, and that 长春仙馆 still matches the album with a theatre in its west court. YM22, YM28, YM31, YM36, YM48, YM50, YM51 only appear in its table of dated changes. The plan is a Yangshi Lei document and research-only; no copy saved. Page gives no author.

title: 《一幅样式雷圆明园全图的年代推断》: NLC plan 043-001 dated by the outlines of scenes
method_stated: Compares outlines on dated plans with archive dates of rebuilding; yellow labels that do not avoid the Daoguang taboo rule out a Daoguang date.
caveat: A reading of Qing plans, not a reconstruction.
notes: A plan reading. 接秀山房 outline on 043-001 predates 观澜堂 (1817-19 per the text). 平湖秋月 and 北远山村 are said to be too rough on this sheet to check. Page gives no author.

author: assumed: the author of 《圆明园变迁史探微》
title: 《“样式雷”图与圆明园》: survey of about 1700 Yangshi Lei plans, naming scenes changed after 1744
method_stated: Writer read all NLC plans in 1990 and cross-checked 1933 survey and Jin Xun plans, and says 金勋 names are about half reliable.
caveat: A reading of Qing plans, not a reconstruction.
notes: A survey, not a drawing. Useful warning: plans almost all show Daoguang to Tongzhi, and a few 1933 survey footprints are 同治 plans never built.

title: 从《春和园纪游诗》论绮春园的早期历史风貌: plan 样101-7 《清夏斋》 read as the early 春和园
method_stated: Reads a Yangshi Lei plan against a poem cycle on the garden; a conjecture in the writer's own terms.
caveat: A reading of Qing plans, not a reconstruction.
notes: A plan reading. 延英论道 is the only hall labelled on 样101-7, three bays, and survives onto 样101-1. 庄严法界 appears only in a list the writer quotes from others: guess. Page gives no author.
